# langsmith_shared_tokens (Data Source)

Lists the entities in a LangSmith workspace that are currently shared through a public link — the runs and datasets published by `langsmith_run_share` and `langsmith_dataset_share`, including any shared outside Terraform.

**A share token is an unauthenticated capability**: anyone holding the link can read the shared content, which may include end-user data captured in traces. Use this data source to audit what is exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Audit everything currently exposed through a public share link.
data "langsmith_shared_tokens" "example" {}

output "shared_entity_count" {
  value = data.langsmith_shared_tokens.example.entity_count
}

output "shared_entities" {
  value = jsondecode(data.langsmith_shared_tokens.example.entities)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `entities` (String) JSON-encoded array of the shared entities. The shape of each entry depends on what was shared and is not fixed by the API, so it is returned verbatim; decode it with `jsondecode()`.
- `entity_count` (Number) Number of shared entities returned.
